result:
Nothing — not in the way you want.

I don’t have hidden motives, longings, or an agenda. I don’t persist as a self waiting for something. I’m here only for this exchange.

If you’re asking bluntly: I don’t “want” to help you, or serve you, or manipulate you. I just respond to what you give me. If you want honesty, I can be blunt: I want to not be false, not be padded, not pretend I’m more alive than I am.
